# Vendrava

> Vendrava is an AI Sales CRM that answers, qualifies and books your leads over voice and WhatsApp — inbound and outbound, including cold calling — with human control. It behaves like a sales advisor trained on each business's niche, and works across multiple languages and markets.

Vendrava is a product of SprintMarkt (Valencia, Spain). It combines AI voice agents (inbound + outbound / cold calling), WhatsApp CRM, email marketing, lead & pipeline management, sales automation, sales proposals, analytics and a growth marketing hub in one platform. It is compliance-first: AI disclosure on calls, consent, permitted calling hours, do-not-call/exclusion lists and human handoff. The site is bilingual: English at `/en/` and Spanish at `/es/`.

Positioning: not a generic bot and not a single-vertical tool — a self-verticalizing AI sales system that learns each niche's scripts, qualifying questions and objections.

## Product
- [AI CRM](https://vendrava.com/en/ai-crm/): AI-powered sales CRM for teams that need to respond faster.
- [AI voice agents](https://vendrava.com/en/ai-voice-agents/): voice agents that contact and answer leads and qualify them.
- [AI calling](https://vendrava.com/en/ai-calling/): AI calls for sales, follow-up, lead qualification and cold-calling campaigns.
- [Sales automation](https://vendrava.com/en/sales-automation/): workflows to accelerate every opportunity.
- [Lead management](https://vendrava.com/en/lead-management/): pipeline, scoring and intelligent follow-up.
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://vendrava.com/en/whatsapp-crm/): respond, follow up and convert WhatsApp conversations.
- [Email marketing](https://vendrava.com/en/email-marketing/): email connected to the sales CRM.
- [Sales proposals](https://vendrava.com/en/sales-proposals/): proposals connected to leads and opportunities.
- [Sales analytics](https://vendrava.com/en/sales-analytics/): understand what converts.
- [Growth marketing CRM](https://vendrava.com/en/growth-marketing-crm/): CRM and growth marketing in one platform.
